messages:
marie (support): customer on Dedicated reported intermittent wrong tool_result mapping when we fan out multiple function calls. they see search results attached to the summarizer and vice versa. repro rate ~2% but blocks their CI. c-id=ci_20260318_ab12

david (eng): can you share the request body + any correlation headers? also which Dedicated pool?

marie (support): they sent this payload and headers (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/chat
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>, X-Redwood-Parallel: true, X-Redwood-Trace: rtd-trace-01
Body: {
  \"messages\": [{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"search and summarize corpus\"}],
  \"functions\": [
    {\"name\":\"doc-search\", \"schema\": {\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\": {\"q\": {\"type\":\"string\"}}}},
    {\"name\":\"doc-summarize\", \"schema\": {\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\": {\"text\": {\"type\":\"string\"}}}}
  ]
}
```

They attached a snippet of the response and the customer claims the tool outputs are swapped.

riff (eng-runtime): :eyes: this smells like the async callback merge bug we fixed partially last quarter. hypothesis: assembler assigns result slot IDs based on completion order but looks up tool_id via a non-atomic map that can be mutated by retries -> slot -> wrong tool. can you paste the sanitized worker logs?

marie (support): customer logs show this:
```
[2026-03-18T10:12:31Z] worker-3 finished handler for doc-search -> cb_d3
[2026-03-18T10:12:31Z] worker-9 finished handler for doc-summarize -> cb_d4
[2026-03-18T10:12:31Z] assembler assigned index 0 -> cb_d4
[2026-03-18T10:12:31Z] assembler assigned index 1 -> cb_d3
```
so order of assignment does not match dispatch mapping. also they saw 2 duplicate invocations (client retried).

sam (sre): fyi we correlated a billing blip for that customer during the same window. retry storms + duplicate tool invocations inflated token usage. tracked under billing alert ba-452.

david (eng): two vectors to fix: 1) make assembler use immutable dispatch token -> slot mapping at enqueue time; 2) ensure retry semantics dedupe by dispatch-id so retries don't spawn duplicate tool calls for the same request. priority P1 for dedicated customer.

riff (eng-runtime): quick mitigation: honor header X-Redwood-Parallel: false to force sequential execution, that avoids assembler concurrency. small patch: on dispatch, annotate each call_future with dispatch_seq and persist that mapping in the request context; assembler then merges based on dispatch_seq. i'll open a PR and a small integration test.

marie (support): customer asked for ETA. can we hotfix today? they are willing to schedule a short maintenance window in their Dedicated pool.

riff (eng-runtime): i'll prepare a hotfix PR + unit test. plan: canary to dedicated-pool-7, monitor X-Redwood-Trace values and mismatched result counts. aiming for patch + canary in 6-8 hours. will post PR link and CI.

david (eng): add an integration stress test: spin N parallel requests and assert tool_result.tool_id matches dispatched function name across >1k runs. include header X-Redwood-Trace to correlate. also add an assert in debug builds to detect any swap and emit a diagnostic trace.

sam (sre): add alert: metric "tool_result_mismatch_count" > 0 for any request should page on P0 for Dedicated customers, but for now set to critical on this customer only. rollback knob: set request param serial_functions=true or header X-Redwood-Parallel: false.

marie (support): shared workaround and repro (customer satisfied for now). opening tracker RW-8001, priority P1. attaching repro script they used.

Customer repro script (from them):
```sh
# runs 50 concurrent requests to reproduce
for i in $(seq 1 50); do
  curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"X-Redwood-Parallel: true\" -H \"X-Redwood-Trace: ci-$(printf \"%06d\" $i)\" -d @payload.json https://dedicated.redwood/api/v1/chat &
 done; wait
```

riff (eng-runtime): local test to mimic customer load:
```sh
for i in {1..100}; do 
  curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"X-Redwood-Parallel: true\" -H \"X-Redwood-Trace: repro-$(uuidgen)\" -d @payload.json https://dedicated.redwood/api/v1/chat &
done; wait
```

david (eng): tag eng-sre and eng-infra for rollout monitoring. add rollback plan: if mismatch rate increases post-deploy, flip header X-Redwood-Parallel:false globally for affected pool and roll back patch.
